name: Social-volume collapse exit filter — crowd-attention-gated momentum
rationale: Sustained directional price moves in crypto require a continuous stream of new buyers to maintain velocity. Social volume is a real-time proxy for the pool of engaged participants: while the crowd is actively discussing an asset (high social_volume) there is a marginal buyer pipeline that can absorb and add to price pressure; when social volume collapses back toward baseline, the energy source for the move is exhausted — fewer new participants are being recruited into the trade. This strategy enters on a standard momentum signal (elevated short-horizon return) but requires the crowd to be engaged at entry (social_volume above sv_entry_floor). A cross_down signal exit triggers whenever social_volume falls through the collapse threshold, forcing exit before the now-unsupported position fully gives back gains. The two-layer filter removes both momentum positions with no social fuel (blocked at entry) and positions that lose social fuel mid-trade (exited early). Disconfirmer: if social_volume was never elevated to begin with, the entry is blocked — protecting against entering quiet low-attention moves that are statistically indistinguishable from noise. NOTE: DATA-BLOCKED — social_volume requires LUNARCRUSH_API_KEY; queued until ingested. tier1 + low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: momentum entry gated by elevated social_volume; exit triggered by crowd-interest collapse
